Senior Digital Marketing Manager, Finlytics — Mar 2021 - Present

Managed marketing automation and nurture workflows in HubSpot, improving lead-to-opportunity conversion rates and shortening sales cycles. Collaborated in Agile sprints and tracked work in Jira.

Executed keyword research and on-page SEO fixes that increased top-10 keyword count by 22% and organic registrations by 18%. Supported paid search teams on campaign refinements in Google Ads to align search intent with landing pages. Instrumented GA4 configurations to measure funnel drop-offs and A/B tested meta and title variations. Assisted with HubSpot integration for content distribution analytics. Participated in Agile planning and task management using Jira.

Digital Marketing Manager, Razorpay — Dec 2019 - Oct 2020
Owned demand-generation initiatives for merchant products, combining paid search, analytics, and SEO. Launched Google Ads prospecting campaigns that contributed 30% of new merchant sign-ups in a quarter. Established GA4 goals and custom reports to track merchant onboarding metrics and optimize channel spend. Drove SEO improvements for developer and product docs, reducing support-led churn through better discoverability. Implemented lead lifecycle staging and email sequences in HubSpot to nurture trial merchants. Coordinated work in Agile and maintained tickets in Jira.
